sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (read in memory via zipfile; openpyxl not installed): 'Quality Checks' row 4 (#3 instruction_is_spelled_right_and_uncontaminated: "No real spelling errors and nothing pasted in by mistake (author notes, TODOs, other machines' paths, contradictions).") and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 4 (same check, wording 'stray paths'); no further annotation present for this row; Deterministic Checks descriptions for instruction content/hygiene and placeholder markers
.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r2/task/environment/assets/seed_data.json (keys, users, jobs, applications, message counts, generated_note; for contradiction checks against the brief)
evidence: Frozen file hashes match manifest.json: instruction.md 58b592ff..., hireops_rules.md 0055eb3b..., integration.md ad93f661...; manifest input_sha256 ccf245cd... confirmed. (1) Spelling: extracted the full unique-word list of instruction.md + both note files and read it; no misspellings found. All three files are pure ASCII, no CRLF. Only locale mixing: instruction.md:15 'honour PORT' / 'honouring DB_PATH' (British) vs template-controlled integration.md:7 'honoring DB_PATH' (American) - both valid spellings, not a real spelling error. (2) Contamination: case-insensitive grep over instruction.md, environment/instructions/*.md and environment/assets/seed_data.json for TODO, FIXME, XXX, CHANGE_ME, placeholder, lorem, TBD, http, F:, C:, /Users, /home/, /mnt, qc-cache, workspace/, golden, oracle, judge, rubric, criteri, reward, playwright, claude, luna, gpt, colderwater, version tags -> only benign hits ('changes', 'Staff:'). Template CHANGE_ME stubs (template instruction.md:1, notes.md:1) are fully replaced; template notes.md is not shipped and hireops_rules.md replaces it. No author asides, no duplicated paragraphs; seed generated_note reads 'Starting data exported from the recruiting desk...' (in-world). (3) Contradictions (two clocks/account lists/seed paths, etc.): account list instruction.md:19 matches seed users exactly (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates, same emails/roles); password 'Hireops!2026' identical in instruction.md:19 and hireops_rules.md:11; seed path /assets/seed_data.json identical in instruction.md:15, integration.md:7 and hireops_rules.md:214; DB /app/app.db + DB_PATH consistent; 'fifteen seconds' (instruction.md:5) = '15 seconds' (rules:122); rules §9 claims (three jobs, one long conversation, a few notes, read markers, candidate wording and page size 30 in the file) all true of the seed (3 jobs, APP-101 has 120 messages, 3 notes, 6 reads, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size 30), and wording table rules:190-197 equals seed candidate_status_labels; activity example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair' uses real seed names; no fixed clock is stated anywhere so no second clock value. Port: integration.md:5 'listens on port 3000' vs instruction.md:15 'honour PORT if it's set' and rules:209 listing PORT - complementary, an app honouring PORT with default 3000 satisfies all. Health: instruction.md:15 'never touches the database' vs integration.md:9-10 'answers before database work can block startup' - the stricter instruction wording satisfies both. Runtime relocation: instruction.md:17 '/assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime' agrees with rules:206-208 'find your pages and starting data relative to server.js'. Rules:3-5 'Routes ... are up to you' does not conflict with the specified status codes 401/403/404/409 (codes, not routes). Lessons file: patterns bearing on this row (stale must/must-not drift from tightening rounds, notes left over from earlier versions, public internet address) - none found: no leftover version references, no public URL, no instructions to the builder that exist only for the grader in a contaminating way. Adversarial probes: a conforming app cannot be failed by a contradiction in these texts because every pair of overlapping statements has a common satisfying reading (PORT default, health without DB, seed path). A broken app gains nothing from this row since it concerns text hygiene only. Ambiguities about version bumping on in-stage reorder and undo interaction are fairness/achievability matters (rows 6/27), not contradictions, and are left to those reviewers.
